prompt: The VoiceDebrief-style chat: a right-hand column with a vertical rail, resizable, with the key and the settings in localStorage.
o_que_fez: pt-chat: a new component. A vertical rail on the right edge, a fixed right-hand column, a drag handle with pointer and keyboard resize. The page reflows beside it rather than being covered: <html> carries the class and the width as a custom property.
localStorage holds the width, the open state, the materials sent, the model and the reader's own OpenRouter key. The key never enters a file; the site gate's key-shaped-string tripwire still passes.
assets/conversa.js became engine-only: it emits each tool call and result as it happens, and asks OpenRouter for usage, so the panel shows the path, the bytes and the cost of every round.
Found by screenshot, not by a gate: [hidden] does not hide when a class rule in the same sheet sets display. The panel shipped permanently open across 227 pages while every gate was green.

Browser gate, two changes: it now reads the computed style of every element carrying hidden inside a shadow root, and it waits for data-estado rather than sleeping 400ms, which had made /grafo/ a false red.
Three injection tests run and reverted: a selector absent from the template, a renamed .tpl, and the [hidden] rule removed. All three go red; the files were restored byte-identical.
admin/versions/v0.10.0.md corrected: it named gates 27 and 28, which were renumbered to 34 and 35 in the same commit that shipped it.
nota: A CONSTRUCTION run: no source frozen, no card moved, nothing published. The panel is read-only by construction — every tool is a GET to a file that is already public, and there is no server to write to.
